headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • Oil India’s Q2 revenue was up 48% yoy & up 1.4% qoq; it was 3.1% ahead of Kotak. • Crude sales of 979 kt (up 18% yoy) were 3.9% ahead of our estimates. • Oil India’s Q2 EBITDA was up 94% yoy, was 15% ahead of our estimate, driven by higher crude volumes and lower opex.
